slides.headline: SOMEONE FOUGHT A $1,200 HOSPITAL BILL WITH ONE AI PROMPT AND PAID $180. HERE ARE 7 LIKE THAT
slides.image: Hands holding a phone showing an AI chat interface with a dollar figure visible on screen, warm natural lighting, candid angle

slides.headline: 1) PASTE YOUR HOSPITAL BILL. AI FINDS THE ERRORS AND WRITES THE DISPUTE
slides.body: MOST PEOPLE JUST PAY WHATEVER THE HOSPITAL SENDS. AI READS EVERY LINE AND CATCHES OVERCHARGES YOU WOULD NEVER SPOT. HOW TO: 1. Go to chatgpt.com or claude.ai (both free) 2. Paste or upload your full medical bill 3. Type: "Find billing errors, duplicate charges, and codes that don't match. Write a dispute letter I can email the billing department"
slides.image: Screenshot of Claude.ai showing a medical bill analysis with flagged billing errors and a draft dispute letter visible, real interface

slides.headline: 2) FIND EVERY DISCOUNT CODE BEFORE YOU HIT BUY
slides.body: THERE IS ALMOST ALWAYS A WORKING CODE. NOBODY DIGS FOR IT BECAUSE CHECKING SIX COUPON SITES IS MISERABLE. AI DOES IT IN SECONDS. HOW TO: 1. Open ChatGPT with web search turned on (free) 2. Paste the link of whatever you're about to buy 3. Type: "Find every working discount code, student discount, or cashback offer for this. List each one with the exact code"
slides.image: Screenshot of ChatGPT listing found discount codes with percentages and exact promo codes, real chat UI

slides.headline: 3) RUN A MOCK INTERVIEW THAT CATCHES YOUR WEAK SPOTS
slides.body: AI ASKS THE SAME TOUGH QUESTIONS A REAL INTERVIEWER WOULD, THEN TELLS YOU EXACTLY WHERE YOUR ANSWERS FELL SHORT. PEOPLE WHO DID THIS SAY THE REAL THING FELT LIKE A RERUN. HOW TO: 1. Go to chatgpt.com or claude.ai 2. Paste the job description and your resume 3. Type: "Interview me one question at a time. After each answer, tell me what was weak and how to fix it"
slides.image: Screenshot of Claude running a mock behavioral interview, showing a tough question and honest critique of the user's answer

slides.headline: 4) GET A WORD-FOR-WORD SCRIPT TO NEGOTIATE ANY BILL
slides.body: YOUR PHONE, CABLE, AND INSURANCE BILLS ARE ALMOST ALWAYS NEGOTIABLE. MOST PEOPLE DON'T CALL BECAUSE THEY DON'T KNOW WHAT TO SAY. HOW TO: 1. Open ChatGPT or Claude 2. Type: "I pay $X/month for [service] with [company]. Write a phone script to negotiate a lower rate. Include what to say when they say no" 3. Call the number on your bill and read the script
slides.image: Person holding a phone to their ear while reading a laptop screen showing an AI-generated call script, natural home setting

slides.headline: 5) PHOTOGRAPH YOUR ROOM. GET A REDESIGN AND A SHOPPING LIST UNDER $500
slides.body: AN INTERIOR DESIGNER CHARGES THOUSANDS. AI LOOKS AT YOUR ACTUAL ROOM AND TELLS YOU EXACTLY WHAT TO BUY AND WHERE TO PUT IT. HOW TO: 1. Take a photo from the doorway so the whole room is in frame 2. Upload it to ChatGPT (tap the camera icon, free) 3. Type: "Redesign this room to look modern and clean. Give me a shopping list of real items under $500 I can find on Amazon"
slides.image: Side by side: a real living room photo on the left, ChatGPT redesign suggestion with a visible item list on the right

slides.headline: 6) AI PRICES YOUR STUFF, WRITES THE LISTING, AND HANDLES THE LOWBALLERS
slides.body: THE REASON YOU NEVER SELL THINGS YOU DON'T USE ISN'T THE SELLING. IT'S THE PRICING, THE PHOTOS, AND THE GUY OFFERING HALF AT 11 PM. HOW TO: 1. Photograph everything you want to sell 2. Upload all the photos to ChatGPT or Claude 3. Type: "Price each one fairly, write a Marketplace listing for each, and write a counter if someone lowballs me"
slides.image: Screenshot of ChatGPT with photos of household items uploaded, showing generated prices and ready-to-post listings

slides.headline: 7) DRAFT A RAISE REQUEST BACKED BY REAL MARKET DATA
slides.body: MOST PEOPLE ASK FOR A RAISE WITH NO NUMBERS AND HOPE FOR THE BEST. AI LOOKS UP WHAT YOUR ROLE ACTUALLY PAYS AND WRITES THE EMAIL. HOW TO: 1. Open ChatGPT with web search on 2. Type: "I'm a [title] making $X. Here's what I've done: [list wins]. Write an email requesting a raise with the market salary for my role to back it up" 3. Review it, add your own voice, and send
slides.image: Screenshot of ChatGPT showing a professional raise request email with market salary comparison data visible

caption:
Swipe → 7 AI prompts that save real money, every one written out so you can copy it tonight 💰

1) paste your medical bill and AI finds billing errors and writes the dispute letter, 2) find every working discount code before you hit buy, 3) run a mock interview that catches your weak spots before the real thing, 4) get a word-for-word phone script to negotiate any monthly bill, 5) photograph your room and get a redesign with a shopping list under $500, 6) AI prices your old stuff, writes the listings, and writes the counter when someone lowballs, 7) draft a raise request backed by what your role actually pays in the market

A year ago these would have cost you hundreds in professional fees. Now you type one sentence and get the same result for free. The people saving money aren't smarter. They just know which sentences to type. Running a business? DM us "AI" and we'll show you what this could do for yours.
